In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], during the [[Trioculus affair]], a team of operatives from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''rescued''' [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the ''[[Moffship]]'', which was hovering above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Organa had been abducted by the former self-proclaimed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Trioculus]], who hoped to force her into [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]]. The operatives replaced Organa with a [[Human replica droid]] called [[Leia Organa II]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] Trioculus with her [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The rescue of Leia Organa appeared in the [[1993]] junior novel ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Queen" />
